soloRaidSummaries.wave_description: A massive Rapture carrier. Not only do teams of Raptures lurk in its head and back, but its back barrels also emit earth-scorching beams of light. Its ability to transport such large amounts of Raptures makes it a formidable foe.

A special individual who captures and remolds Nikkes into Rapture parts.
It's time to avenge the countless Nikkes who have fallen prey.
Codename: Spider uses its long legs to wreak havoc both up close and from a distance.

A runaway train that is occupied by Raptures.
It's loaded to the teeth, so watch your back, particularly for the main particle cannon.
No further information. Additional authorization required for query.
No further information. Additional authorization required for query.

An active Rapture during the 1st Rapture Invasion.
Shatters everything that comes in its way with massive physical force.

It thinks like a human and talks like a human.
Its existence itself is a riddle wrapped within a mystery, as next to nothing is known about it.

A type of training device.
Uses special parts as materials.

A mysterious object surrounded by crystals.
No one knows where it comes from or what it wants.

A thunderbird that rules the sky.
It has the ability to manipulate lightning and burn everything.

A two-headed crimson dragon.
The moment she opens her eyes, hellfire spews forth with every breath she takes.

A Rapture in the form of an enlarged Heretic, Indivilia.
Its appearance is reminiscent of a scorpion.
Its long tail serves as its main weapon.
The blade at the tail tip vibrates at a high speed, capable of cutting through anything in its path.

A monster which rules the underground world.
The momentum of its giant drill must be stopped.

Kraken's outer armor shimmers gold as a result of glowing plankton.
Despite its corroded outer armor, it still poses a huge threat as a massive entity that roams the sea freely.

An unknown object that encases the specialized weapon Glass Slippers with crystals.
It employs shards of the Harmony Cube as its 
energy source and lashes out at whoever dares to 
approach.

An entity created by the Gatekeeper, imitating a powerful existence from a certain dimension.
It transforms into multiple forms and launches continuous attacks on the Ark.

A Rapture reminiscent of a tortoise.
Breaking through their stout shell will be the key to winning.

A Rapture into which the Heretic Behemoth has transformed.
She launches continuous attacks with her massive body and pincers that remind one of heavy equipment.

The dragon that rules the world in Guillotine's imagination.
For some reason, it brings to mind someone familiar.
It radiates cold air, freezing the world in Guillotine's imagination.

One of the Heretics, the Queen's elites.
The particle cannon is powered by core energy and is extremely dangerous. Destroy the core as quickly as possible.

A type of training device.
Uses special parts as materials.

An entity created by the Gatekeeper, imitating a powerful existence from a certain dimension.
It transforms into multiple forms and unleashes attacks.

The guardian of the Black Sea created by Leviathan.
It is composed of high-density Dark Matter with a core at its center.
It attacks any entity that invades the Black Sea, be it Raptures or Nikkes.

A unique entity that appeared during the First Rapture Invasion.
It devoured everything including Nikkes, Raptures, and large weapons, thus earning its nickname, Gluttony.
While it is classified as a Tyrant-class entity, it far exceeds that classification in terms of danger and specifications.

An imitation of a powerful existence from a certain dimension, created by the Gatekeeper.
It was summoned alongside Lily. Though usually under her control, it's gone on a rampage for some reason.

A mutated form of the Kraken that slumbers at the bottom of the sea.
It has parts composed of high-density electromagnetic fields, making it appear like a hologram.

A Rapture in the form of the Heretic Ziz in her enlarged form.
Surrounded by energy shields, it soars through the air at high speeds while attacking.

A massive Rapture carrier. Not only do teams of Raptures lurk in its head and back, but its back barrels also emit earth-scorching beams of light. Its ability to transport such large amounts of Raptures makes it a formidable foe.

An entity created by Torch of Salvation to judge mankind's sins.
Shrouded in a thick defensive barrier, it seeks to enforce its verdict on humanity.

An entity that has long been circling in orbit, waiting.
The Rapture Queen—the root cause of it all.
She wields power and abilities befitting her name.
A runaway train that is occupied by Raptures. It's loaded to the teeth, so be careful of its many armaments, particularly the main particle cannon.

A one-of-a-kind entity in this world created by the Four Beasts and crafted with unwavering dedication over a long period of time.
She possesses perfect command over Dark Matter.

A new elite unit created by the Queen upon her descent to the surface.
Wearing the benevolent face of a zealot devoted solely to the Queen, she imitates the shields of familiar allies.

A mysterious object surrounded by crystals.
No one knows where it comes from or what it wants.
A new elite Heretic made by the Queen after descending to the surface. With a fierce, battle-hungry look in her eyes, she imitates a sword and wings that both feel familiar.

An active Rapture during the 1st Rapture Invasion.
Shatters everything that comes in its way with massive physical force.
A new Rapture created by the Queen after her descent to the surface. Modeled after the bullet of someone familiar, its cold metal contains within it the death of someone unforgotten.
A Land Eater variant that had been slumbering in the ocean. Unlike regular Land Eaters, this one takes the form of an island rather than a building.
Codename: Spider uses its long legs to wreak havoc both up close and from a distance.

A giant body made from the frame of someone close to the Queen. 
Without a head to think, the quiet heart simply discharges an unending barrage of torrents in silence.

A new elite unit created by the Queen upon her descent to the surface.
Wearing the benevolent face of a zealot devoted solely to the Queen, she imitates the shields of familiar allies.
